query:
-- Löschen aller Produkt-Compliance-Checks für RIVA
DELETE pci FROM product_compliance_items pci
INNER JOIN product_compliance_checks pcc ON pci.checkId = pcc.id
WHERE pcc.supplierId = 90001;

DELETE FROM product_compliance_checks WHERE supplierId = 90001;

-- Website-Check-Items: CE-Marking als not_applicable korrigieren
UPDATE supplier_check_items 
SET status = 'not_applicable',
    finding = 'CE marking is NOT required for passive water filters (activated carbon block, hollow fibre membrane, crystal scale inhibitor). These are passive mechanical devices with no electrical components, no pressure vessels above threshold, and no moving parts. CE would only be mandatory for UV-lamp filters or electrically-pumped RO systems. Applying CE without a relevant directive would actually be unlawful misuse of the marking.',
    criticality = 'info',
    recommendation = 'Do NOT request CE marking from RIVA. Instead focus on: VO (EG) 1935/2004 declaration, KTW-W270 material assessment, DVGW W512 certification.'
WHERE regulationCode = 'CE-Marking' 
AND checkId IN (SELECT id FROM supplier_website_checks WHERE supplierId = 90001);

-- EU-BauPVO ebenfalls als not_applicable markieren
UPDATE supplier_check_items 
SET status = 'not_applicable',
    finding = 'Construction Products Regulation (305/2011) does not apply to portable or under-sink water filters. No harmonised European product standard (hEN) exists for drinking water filter devices under this regulation.',
    criticality = 'info',
    recommendation = 'Not applicable for RIVA water filter products.'
WHERE regulationCode = 'EU-BauPVO' 
AND checkId IN (SELECT id FROM supplier_website_checks WHERE supplierId = 90001);

SELECT COUNT(*) as remaining_checks FROM product_compliance_checks WHERE supplierId = 90001;
